Bill.BriefDescription: Preventing denial of insurance coverage for injuries caused by narcotic or alcohol use.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to insurance coverage for injuries sustainedbecause of alcohol or narcotic use; adding a new section to chapter48.20 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.21 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 48.44 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.46RCW; creating new sections; and repealing RCW 48.20.272.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that an alcohol ordrugrelated injury that requires treatment in an emergency departmentcan be a critical moment in the life of a person with a substance abuseproblem. Studies have demonstrated that appropriate interventions byhospital staff at these times can reduce substance abuse and lowerfuture health care costs. The perception among health care providersthat they may be penalized by insurers for conducting theseinterventions prevents many of them from performing interventions whichcan make all the difference to a person at the crossroads of asubstance abuse problem.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An insurer may not deny coverage for the treatment of an injurysolely because the injury was sustained as a consequence of theinsured's being intoxicated or under the influence of a narcotic.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An insurer may not deny coverage for the treatment of an injurysolely because the injury was sustained as a consequence of theinsured's being intoxicated or under the influence of a narcotic.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A health care service contractor may not deny coverage for thetreatment of an injury solely because the injury was sustained as aconsequence of the enrolled participant's being intoxicated or underthe influence of a narcotic.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A health maintenance organization may not deny coverage for thetreatment of an injury solely because the injury was sustained as aconsequence of the enrolled participant's being intoxicated or underthe influence of a narcotic.
RCW 48.20.272 (Optional standard provisionNo. 23Intoxicants and narcotics) and 1951 c 229 s 28 are eachrepealed.
This act applies to all contracts issued orrenewed on or after the effective date of this act.
